case_title: KANHAIYA LAL & ORS. v. STATE OF RAJASTHAN
high_court_outcome: Partly allowed appeals, converted death sentences to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The incident involved five persons being killed by blows with swords, gandasis, and sticks. The crime was allegedly motivated by a prior incident where the son of a village Sarpanch was murdered, and the Sarpanch suspected the deceased were involved. The accused formed an unlawful assembly with a common object to kill the deceased. The FIR was delayed, but the explanation for the delay was not implausible. Witnesses, who had lost family members, testified about the weapons used, the assault, and injuries inflicted. The trial court convicted 17 accused, including six with death sentences and 11 with life imprisonment, while acquitting the rest. The High Court partially allowed appeals, converting death sentences to life imprisonment and acquitting some accused.
